title: Perfect!
body: I have had the free version for 12 days now and guess what. My Streak is 12 days! 💪 i have tried many a habit tracker before, nothing worked… the Home Screen Widget is absolutely beautiful and it reminds and motivates me. The app is ad free and NEVER asks to upgrade to pro. The pro version is also very reasonably priced with no subscription. I will definitely upgrade once i am ready to add more habits. Shout out to the developer, we need more apps like this one 🙌🙌
author: Neyghey

title: Great app but need few feature
body:
Great simple app but needs an interactive widget to check the streak from the widget by itself rather than opening the app.
Another feature if we can get a icon to put in front of our streak task name, that would be awesome

author: essakd

title: Great way to keep track!
body: I was pretty lax about taking my medication’s until I was able to make a game of it. This app did just the thing. I have several friends who have used it to track sobriety and it is simple and to the point. I made the purchase of the app as well. Well worth the cost.  My request for support and help was answered promptly as well. I Feel great supporting a small app developer.

title: Works great but not on old iPhones
body:
Feature doesn’t swipe on iPhone SE. I go to swipe and the GUI shows like it use easy but nothing moves when I swipe. Tried closing and reopening the app, same issue. So app is pointless at this point unless I want to use auto mode.

Got an iPhone 14 and everything works perfectly

title: Perfection in Simplicity
